stem_book: Find the moment of inertia of the uniform solid half cylinder of mass M and radius R shown in figure, about the axis AA′. (AA′ is parallel to the cylinder's axis and touches the curved surface along the line farthest from the flat face, i.e. at distance R from the cylinder's axis.)
reason: figure-only position of AA′ written into the stem; 'solid' made explicit.
work: I_axis = MR²/2, CM at 4R/(3π): I_AA′ = MR²/2 − M(4R/3π)² + M(R − 4R/3π)² = MR²(3/2 − 8/(3π)) = ((9π−16)/(6π))MR²
